blocks.text: Jollibee brought a new level of innovation and sustainability to Cebu with the opening of its City di Mare store, introducing several first-of-its-kind features in the Visayas and Mindanao (VisMin) region. Located along Cebu South Coastal Road in Barangay Mambaling, the two-story Jollibee City di Mare Drive-Thru is the brand’s first store of its kind in VisMin, combining innovative customer facilities, family-friendly spaces and environmentally conscious technologies. “Cebu has always held a special place in the Jollibee story, and opening our very first store of this kind in VisMin at City di Mare reflects our commitment to growing alongside this vibrant […]...
